title: Displayed missing-attendance batch removal fix
userReport: User reported that checking/clicking 표시 항목 for 확인 필요한 미기록 수업 still did not make displayed items disappear, possibly due hardcoded behavior.
changes: Changed resolved proposal suppression to hide confirmed/batch-confirmed/manual-save keys immediately instead of requiring an additional matching-log check.
Added _applyAttendanceProposalBatch so displayed proposal keys are marked resolved for every listed item during batch processing.
Made 표시 항목 출석 확정 one-tap apply instead of opening a second confirmation dialog that could make the click appear ineffective.
Kept 결석 batch behind confirmation, but it uses the same forced displayed-item resolution path.
Bumped service worker cache version to vs-v2-2026-06-19-proposal-batch-fix and updated regression gates.

localBrowser.scenario: Synthetic fixed student with two displayed missing-attendance proposals; call confirmAttendanceProposalBatch(출석).

residualBlockers: Actual server data on Vercel still requires user admin Google login on the Vercel domain.
G004/G005 live split-write and Storage upload receipts still require a logged-in admin browser to run 관리자 검증 → 라이브 G004/G005 검증 and provide/copy the JSON receipt.
